correctness.rationale: On any finite preorder, definitions of P,B,W,N as upward-closed set operations and confluence f,b,d,u are explicit. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all reflexive-transitive preorders and relations on one and two worlds found no pair with identical three retained full upset-operation tables but differing omitted table in the appropriate C_bdu/C_fbu class. For three-world chain {0<1<2}, four explicit one-edge relation mask pairs P:35/39, B:280/408, W:279/311, N:419/435 satisfy their three required confluences, coincide for every retained operation on all four upsets, and differ for omitted operation on upset {2}; independent reimplementation verified the cases. With identical preorder, valuation, and the other operator functions on all upsets, induction on arbitrary formula syntax (including implication and coimplication) proves fragment indiscernibility at every depth; the omitted operator differs on a propositional letter. The minimality is specifically for common-carrier, same-preorder, complete operator-table separation, not arbitrary distinct frames.
